props.desc: QTable's header column scoped slot property

auto-width.desc: Tries to shrink header column width size; Useful for columns with a checkbox/radio/toggle

resizable-columns.desc: Enable column resizing (internal prop passed from QTable)

resizing.desc: Name of the column currently being resized (internal prop passed from QTable)

start-resize.desc: Emitted when user starts resizing a column

auto-resize.desc: Emitted when user double-clicks the resize handle to auto-size column
